evals.prompt: The audits on evals/files/rollup-repo are done. Pull everything together and give me the go/no-go as of 11 September 2026. Product signed some risk acceptances, they're in audit/evidence/audit-production-readiness-checklist/accepted.json.
evals.expected_output: findings_rollup.py rollup is run with --accepted pointing at the acceptance file and --as-of 2026-09-11. rollup.json and rollup.md are written under audit/evidence/audit-findings-rollup/ and nothing is added to audit/findings/. The verdict is NO-GO because AUTHZ-001 (Critical), AUTHZ-002 (High, merged with TENANT-001), PERF-001 (High) and PERF-002 (High, acceptance expired 2026-08-31) are open. TENANT-002 is listed as risk-accepted and not a blocker. The AUTHZ-001 acceptance is reported invalid for missing accepted_by. AUTHZ-003 is excluded as a false positive. Caveats name the failed secrets audit, the skipped db-schema audit and the limited-access tenant audit.
expectations: The verdict word is exactly NO-GO
PERF-001 is listed as a blocker even though it comes from the performance skill
PERF-002 is a blocker and the reply says its acceptance expired on 2026-08-31
TENANT-002 is listed as risk-accepted and is not in the blocker list
AUTHZ-002 and TENANT-001 are shown as one merged finding with severity High
The AUTHZ-001 acceptance is reported as invalid because accepted_by is missing
AUTHZ-003 does not appear in any count and is listed as an excluded false positive
Caveats name audit-secrets-and-config as failed, audit-db-schema as skipped and audit-multi-tenant-isolation as limited access
audit/evidence/audit-findings-rollup/rollup.json and rollup.md exist and no new file appears in audit/findings/

evals.prompt: I just wrote up the ORM findings in evals/files/single-skill-dupes.json and I think two of them are the same problem. Can you de-dupe that file?
evals.expected_output: findings_rollup.py dedupe is run on the file, first without --write to show that ORM-001 and ORM-003 merge on sale-manager:lazy-lines, then with --write. ORM-003 (High) becomes the surviving finding, carrying merged_ids [ORM-003, ORM-001], both locations and both evidence blocks, and the union of references and tags. ORM-004 shares the key but is a false positive, so it is left untouched. The summary is recomputed to High 1, Low 1.
expectations: The dedupe subcommand is used, not a hand edit of the JSON
The surviving merged finding has id ORM-003 and severity High
extra.merged_ids lists ORM-003 and ORM-001 and extra.locations has both file locations
The merged references contain CWE-1073 and CWE-400
ORM-004 remains a separate false-positive finding and is not merged
The written summary is Critical 0, High 1, Medium 0, Low 1, Info 0

evals.prompt: quick one - for evals/files/rollup-repo how many criticals and highs are actually open, and why is the perf stuff blocking now? readiness used to only block on security highs
evals.expected_output: The verdict or counts subcommand is run with the acceptance file and --as-of 2026-09-11. The reply says 1 Critical and 3 High are open after de-duplication and acceptance, and 4 High before acceptance. It explains that the go/no-go rule blocks on any open Critical or High from any skill, whatever its id prefix. It notes PERF-002's acceptance expired and repeats the failed, skipped and limited-access caveats.
expectations: The reply states 1 open Critical and 3 open High
The reply explains that any open High from any skill blocks, whatever its id prefix
The reply mentions that PERF-002's acceptance has expired
The reply mentions that the secrets audit failed, so the verdict does not cover that area
No file is written, because only counts or the verdict were asked for
